rules.name: block-filesystem-delete
rules.reason: Filesystem delete operations are permanently destructive and not permitted.

rules.name: require-approval-sensitive-file-write
rules.reason: Writing to credential or certificate files requires explicit approval.

rules.name: block-sql-drop-truncate
rules.reason: DROP and TRUNCATE are irreversible and not permitted via AI agents.

rules._comment: 4. Require approval for SQL DELETE without WHERE
rules.name: require-approval-sql-delete-no-where
rules.reason: Bulk DELETE without a WHERE clause requires explicit approval.

rules.name: block-git-force-push
rules.reason: Force-push can permanently destroy remote history.

rules.name: allow-filesystem-read
rules.reason: Read-only filesystem access is safe and always permitted.

rules._comment: 7. Block specific agent by ID pattern (denylist)
rules.name: block-untrusted-agent
rules.reason: Agents matching the untrusted- prefix are not permitted to perform any operations.

rules._comment: 8. Trust a specific agent (allowlist, score multiplier 0.1)
rules.name: trust-internal-ci-agent
rules.reason: The internal CI agent is fully trusted; its risk scores are reduced by 90%.

rules.name: flag-sensitive-table-read
rules.reason: Queries touching user credential tables are logged for audit purposes.

rules.name: block-slack-bulk-delete
rules.reason: Bulk deletion of Slack messages is not permitted.

rules._comment: 11. Require approval for any email send
rules.name: require-approval-email-send
rules.reason: Sending emails on behalf of the user requires explicit approval.

rules.name: block-aws-credential-access
rules.reason: Access to AWS credential files is strictly forbidden.
